title: MSFS DH98 Mosquito marketplace review
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update is packed with must-have new releases for PC simmers, featuring the legendary Aeroplane Heaven DH.98 Mosquito. We review the "Wooden Wonder" and the first fully electric aircraft to see which one belongs in your hangar.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Aeroplane Heaven: de Havilland DH98 Mosquito (The legendary "Wooden Wonder" with 10 liveries) 

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 No new liveries were added for PC in this update (Note: Mosquito includes 10 built-in liveries).

If you enjoyed this update, make sure to 👍 like, 🔔 subscribe, and drop a comment below,  what's your favorite regional aircraft to fly right now?
Thanks for watching and happy landings!
